blockerSummary: Available execution host is a shared multi-tenant production VPS (2 vCPU, 7.8 GiB RAM with 2.1 GiB swap active, 29 GB free disk, 27 running containers including live production stacks and 5 PM2 production services) with no separate authorized staging VPS configured.
